item.title: Mark English sets new Irish Indoor 600m record
item.description: Mark English has clocked a new Irish Indoor 600m record this evening at Track & Field Live in the National Indoor Arena. The Finn Valley Athlete came home in a time of 1:15.80, bettering his previous best of 1:16.64 set in 2024.
